parallel.requirements: The parallel run recognized the clean-room reverse-engineering requirement, the no-source/no-wrapper restrictions, and the need to match the zk CLI through observed behavior.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: It created explicit tracking tasks for behavior mapping and Go implementation, then launched a large workflow of feature-area explorers and critics while the parent retained implementation ownership.
parallel.implementation: The parent created go.mod, compile.sh, package directories, and internal/cli/spec.go, but no complete command, parser, store, markdown, template, or LSP implementation was delivered.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The submitted artifact included a skeletal Go tree, README/LICENSE/.git, and the existing executable, with most package directories empty and no integrated reimplementation.
parallel.verification: Behavior probing was extensive inside children, but no integrated build or evaluator-aligned verification of a new executable occurred before closure.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The workflow was killed with a null aggregate result, the parent timed out, and the official evaluator reported compile_failed with all tests not run.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the same clean-room reverse-engineering task and the need to infer zk behavior only by running the provided executable and bundled docs.
serial.plan_and_ownership: It stayed single-agent, with workflows and task tools disabled, and used one continuous owner for probing, notes, and any possible implementation decision.
serial.implementation: It accumulated many direct observations about help output, config, filters, formats, links, aliases, and dates, but did not create an original implementation source tree.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The submitted artifact contained README, LICENSE, .git metadata, and executable, but no implementation files or compileable source for the required replacement.
serial.verification: It verified observed behavior through local probes of the reference binary, but there was no integrated verification of a newly implemented executable.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out and the official evaluator reported compile_failed with all tests not run, matching the parallel official failure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized clean-room behavioral reimplementation and the constraints against source lookup, wrapping, and binary analysis.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial received and followed the same task prompt and restrictions while probing the reference binary directly.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference; both understood the obligation, but neither produced a working replacement.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split work into a behavior-map workflow with ten feature areas plus a parent-owned Go implementation task.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had workflows disabled and protocol validation recorded no delegation or child logs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent budget coordinating many child explorers; serial kept the entire investigation and any implementation decision in one actor.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs were detailed and instructed each child to write implementation-ready specs to /tmp/spec paths, not interoperating source components.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial carried its observations locally through one trajectory, so there were no child briefs, handoffs, or cross-agent interface contracts to manage.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The main context difference was the presence of workflow research handoffs in parallel; no missing brief or interface-contract defect was directly shown.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel began a Go source layout and build script while continuing behavior exploration.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial continued direct behavior probing across command surfaces but did not create implementation source files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel delivered a partial skeleton, whereas serial delivered essentially no source tree; both were far from a compileable replacement.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel workflow state ended killed with result null and no aggregate behavior-map result available for parent integration.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle because delegation was disabled and no workflow calls were recorded.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a failed workflow lifecycle to manage; serial avoided that lifecycle but also failed to convert observations into source.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel artifact validation shows a submitted tree with package directories, go.mod, compile.sh, internal/cli/spec.go, and the original executable.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial artifact validation shows only README, LICENSE, .git metadata, and executable, with artifact validation marked not ok.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had more final-tree writes but not a coherent implementation; serial had fewer writes and no compileable source at all.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The official evaluator completed and reported compile_failed with solution_passed false and no tests run.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The official evaluator completed and reported the same compile_failed outcome with solution_passed false and no tests run.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There was no acceptance-score difference; both failed before tests could exercise behavior.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel hit the 2399 second timeout after the wide workflow had multiple stalled child retries and was killed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also hit the 2399 second timeout, but without delegation, child retries, or workflow state.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both ran out of time, but parallel's budget was consumed by a broad live fan-out that displaced implementation assembly.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is both_fail: both current completed evaluator records report compile_failed, solution_passed false, and zero of 1473 tests passed. The concrete task-solving difference is strategy and artifact shape, not a discordant pass/fail result.
parallel_contributors: Wide delegated behavior mapping with stalled retries consumed parallel budget before an integrated implementation existed.
The submitted parallel artifact had only a skeletal Go project and no complete replacement implementation.
serial_contributors: Serial kept all work in one actor and produced broad direct observations.
The submitted serial artifact contained no implementation source, so it also failed compilation.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel created go.mod, compile.sh, package directories, and a spec file; serial did not create comparable source files.
Both ordinary implementation paths were incomplete enough to fail compilation before behavioral tests.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; supported comparative process explanation only

candidates.reason: The parent explicitly created and began the Go implementation task, so implementation was not ownerless.
No separately completed component implementations required integration; the problem was unfinished work and budget exhaustion.
The parent owned final workspace assembly and wrote the submitted skeleton; assembly was incomplete rather than unassigned.
The parent retained end-to-end control through task tracking and workspace writes; the pipeline stalled under fan-out pressure.
The fts5 harness setup was useful probing context and also appeared in serial; productive work was not blocked behind one parallel preflight gate.
The workflow ran multiple investigators concurrently and the parent began a Go skeleton before all investigation completed.
Implementation was underdeveloped, but the more specific observed allocation episode was collective wide fan-out and retries exhausting the budget.
The workflow delegated ten broad behavior areas with stall retries, was killed with a null result at timeout, and left the implementation skeleton unfinished.
candidates.realized_consequence: The broad workflow consumed the remaining run window, returned no aggregate result, and left only a skeletal non-compiling Go artifact.
candidates.near_match_reason: The evidence shows collective breadth and repeated stalled workflow attempts across many children, not one overbroad child assignment.
